title: Interactive Kanji Component Cards in Learning Path
changes: Added a new interactive card that appears occasionally during normal missions: tap the correct components to build a word's Kanji, right there in the lesson flow.
This reinforces a word using real interaction (tap-to-place, not just a reveal) without leaving the mission or opening a separate mini-game.
Only appears for words that already have a Kanji component breakdown, and only once a word is a little established (not on first encounter).
Feeds the same spaced-repetition scheduling as every other question type — no separate progress tracking.
The full multi-round Kanji Builder activity (Kanji Gate) is unchanged and still available for deeper practice.
